heard: Akrotiri is the Pompeii where nobody died. Volcanic ash buried the city, though the exact date remains debated. In 1967, Spirit and Maranatos began excavating the volcanic debris. He found three-story buildings and colorful frescoes. Unlike Pompeii, no human remains were found. Proceeding earthquakes likely warned the population to flee. The people escaped leaving behind a ghost town.
